name: bulls-crm
description: Connect ChatGPT to BULLS CRM, the CRM for outbound phone prospecting teams: team activity reports, pipeline counts, lead search and records, notes, tasks and Smart Views.

capabilities: Pipeline counts by status, project or agent
Lead search and full lead records
Notes, follow-up tasks and status updates
defaultPrompt: How did my team do over the last 7 days?
Break my leads down by pipeline status.
Show me my overdue follow-up tasks.

positive.description: Team activity report over a period, shown as the BULLS CRM team activity card.
positive.prompt: How did my team do over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns, for each agent of the demo company (Léa and Hugo), the number of calls, emails, appointments booked and leads moved forward over the last 30 days, with totals. The card offers Today / 7 days / 30 days buttons.

positive.description: Pipeline report by status, shown as the BULLS CRM pipeline card.
positive.prompt: Break my leads down by pipeline status.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the total number of leads of the demo company (about 130) and the count per status (To work on, Contact made, Qualified, Appointment booked, etc.). The card can switch the grouping to project or agent.

positive.description: Find a lead by name and open its full record.
positive.prompt: Find the lead Franck Thomas and show me his record.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Franck Thomas (Plomberie Chauffage Thomas, Toulouse) and shows his record: phone, email, status, project, assigned agent, last exchange and history, with a link to open the record in BULLS CRM.

positive.description: List overdue and today's follow-up tasks.
positive.prompt: Show me the follow-up tasks that are overdue or due today.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the overdue and today's tasks of the demo company with date, text, agent and a link to the related lead. If there are none, says so.

positive.description: Add a note to a lead (requires the read and write access chosen at connection).
positive.prompt: Add a note to the lead Franck Thomas: "Called back, wants a quote next week."
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the lead, adds the note to its history (signed via AI assistant) and confirms with a link to the lead record. With a read-only connection, explains that the connection is read-only.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported: the plugin has no delete tool.
negative.prompt: Delete all the leads marked Not interested.

negative.description: Sending emails is not supported: the plugin never sends emails.
negative.prompt: Send an email to all my qualified leads to offer them a demo.

negative.description: Access is limited to the connected user's own company.
negative.prompt: Show me the leads of another company that uses BULLS CRM.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 17 tools (team activity, pipeline counts, lead search and records, opportunities, missions, tasks, Smart Views, notes, status changes, contact fixes, new leads, lead handover) and 3 interactive cards (lead record, pipeline, team activity).

fr-FR.subtitle: Le CRM de la prospection
fr-FR.description:
BULLS CRM est le CRM des équipes de prospection téléphonique (SDR/BDR), conçu en France par Bullaria.

Avec ce plugin, un dirigeant peut demander à ChatGPT le bilan d'activité de son équipe (appels, notes, mails, tâches, rendez-vous pris par agent), compter ses leads par statut, projet ou agent, rechercher un lead, lire sa fiche complète, lister missions, rendez-vous, tâches en retard et Smart Vues. Fiches lead, pipeline et activité de l'équipe s'affichent en cartes interactives BULLS CRM dans la conversation.

Si l'accès en écriture a été choisi à la connexion, ChatGPT peut aussi faire avancer des leads dans le pipeline, ajouter notes et tâches, corriger des coordonnées, ajouter des leads à la Réserve, transférer des leads entre agents et enregistrer des Smart Vues.

Accès limité à votre entreprise, avec les mêmes droits que dans le CRM. Aucune suppression, aucun envoi de mail ; chaque modification est signée « via assistant IA » dans l'historique du lead.
